text.aria-label: Title text 'Recovery of injected PV capacity at the six MW Primaries (1 is exact; grey band is the 0.8 to 1.2 pass bar) Dot: median over 2 cutoffs, 3 seeds and 2 farm rotations. Line: range of those. Recovery is the probed capacity minus the uninjected twin's, over the injected MW.'
text.tspan: Recovery of injected PV capacity at the six MW Primaries (1 is exact; grey band is the 0.8 to 1.2 pass bar)
Dot: median over 2 cutoffs, 3 seeds and 2 farm rotations. Line: range of those. Recovery is the probed capacity minus the uninjected twin's, over the injected MW.
